evidence.detail: Missing prerequisite: normalized canonical nonregular weight-to-regular cell maps, their adjointness, fiber leading coefficient, and first-standardization scalar propagation. Current Proof 2.1 introduces U_T,V_T without formulas, asserts V_T f_t=pi_t psi_T and leading coefficient 1 for U_T psi_T, then obtains the crucial norm by adjointness. The Schur-functor theorem proves only the regular corner, while the seminormal theorem proves standard-tableau action; neither supplies these weight maps. Attempted closure: a leading scalar cannot be inferred merely from map normalization or bubble-sort connectivity without a defined action and the nonsemistandard higher-term reduction. Current producer contract 2.1 repeats this inference and manifest keeps the full all-weight determinant claim. Read complete relevant Mathas Lemmas 5.13-5.17 and Theorem 5.18 proofs, printed pp.49-51: the canonical phi_T^omega/phi_omega^T maps, higher-term control and scalar calculation are separate necessary arguments. Owner must route their complete local proof to batch 13 and explicitly resolve the current proof; Schur basis escalation also remains upstream. No producer edits and no completion confidence claimed.
